title: Sprout Social vs Emplifi vs Agorapulse: Which Fits Your Team in 2026?
summary: Sprout Social vs Emplifi vs Agorapulse compared on pricing, module bundling, and video listening — see which all-in-one social suite actually fits in 2026.
body_markdown:
**TL;DR:** Sprout Social, Emplifi, and Agorapulse all sell themselves as one platform for publishing, listening, analytics, and care — but they bundle those modules three different ways, and none of them reads what's actually said or shown inside a video. Agorapulse is the cheapest self-serve entry at $79/user/month, Sprout Social bundles listening into its $199 tier, and Emplifi sells listening as a paid add-on on every single plan. If your real signal lives in spoken audio or on-screen visuals rather than a caption, all three hit the same wall.


On May 13, 2026, Sprout Social announced Trellis — an agentic AI layer it's rolling out across Publishing, Listening, Smart Inbox, and Reporting, with full availability promised by July 2026 (Source:[Sprout Social Press Release, 2026](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/press/sprout-social-unveils-its-ai-powered-social-intelligence-platform-and-the-expansion-of-its-proprietary-ai-agent-trellis/) ). Read that announcement carefully and it says something quiet but telling: these modules didn't feel unified enough on their own, so an AI layer had to be built to stitch them together.


That's the real tension behind Sprout Social vs Emplifi vs Agorapulse. All three market themselves as "all-in-one" social suites, but each one bundles publishing, analytics, listening, and care into a different shape — and the more modules a suite claims, the shallower each one tends to get. Pick the wrong bundle and you either overpay for modules you'll never touch or underpay for the one module — listening — that decides whether you catch what customers actually say.


This comparison breaks down what each platform costs, what's really included at each tier, which team size each one fits, and the gap all three share: none of them understands a video the way they understand a caption.


## Sprout Social vs Emplifi vs Agorapulse: At-a-Glance Comparison


Sprout Social is the mid-market suite betting on one AI layer to tie its modules together, Emplifi is the enterprise ladder that sells three separate product lines, and Agorapulse is the cheapest self-serve option in the group. Here's how they compare on what actually determines fit.

Sprout Social and Agorapulse both publish self-serve pricing directly on their sites; Emplifi only recently published a self-serve rate for its Social Marketing line, while its Social Care and Social Commerce lines remain quote-only (Source:[Sprout Social Pricing, 2026](https://sproutsocial.com/pricing/) ;[Agorapulse Pricing, 2026](https://www.agorapulse.com/pricing) ;[Emplifi Pricing, 2026](https://emplifi.io/pricing/) ). All three call the monitoring module "listening" — but as this comparison shows, none of them means "listening" the way a video-first brand needs it to.


## How They Compare Head-to-Head


Each platform bundles its modules differently. Here's what each genuinely offers, and where the bundle breaks down.


### Sprout Social: The Mid-Market Pick Betting on One AI Layer Across Four Modules


Sprout Social runs five tiers: Essentials at $79/seat/month (annual) or $99 monthly, Standard at $199, Professional at $299, Advanced at $399, and a custom Enterprise tier. Keyword and location monitoring — its baseline listening feature — is bundled starting at Standard ($199); sentiment analysis across the inbox and reviews doesn't arrive until Advanced ($399) (Source:[Sprout Social Pricing, 2026](https://sproutsocial.com/pricing/) ).


On May 13, 2026, Sprout announced Trellis, an agentic AI platform extending across Publishing, Listening, Smart Inbox, and Reporting, with rollout to all customers completing in July 2026 (Source:[Sprout Social Press Release, 2026-05-13](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/press/sprout-social-unveils-its-ai-powered-social-intelligence-platform-and-the-expansion-of-its-proprietary-ai-agent-trellis/) ;[GlobeNewswire, 2026-05-13](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/13/3294046/0/en/sprout-social-unveils-its-ai-powered-social-intelligence-platform-and-the-expansion-of-its-proprietary-ai-agent-trellis.html) ). The pitch is explicit: turn data scattered across separate modules into one organization-wide action layer — which only matters if those modules were disconnected to begin with.


**Where Sprout wins:** Listening arrives at a lower tier than either competitor's comparable feature set, and it carries roughly 6,900-7,400 G2 reviews at 4.4/5, with genuine self-serve access and a real 30-day trial.


**Where it struggles:** Its own support documentation admits Sprout "cannot search and sync sound" on TikTok because of platform API limits (Source:[Sprout Social Support — TikTok FAQs, 2026](https://support.sproutsocial.com/hc/en-us/articles/6136845197709-TikTok-FAQs) ) — listening is confirmed text, hashtag, caption, and mention-based, not video-native. Third-party comparisons also flag Sprout's overall per-seat cost as a stretch for early-stage teams once headcount adds up (Source:[Statusbrew — Sprout Social vs Agorapulse, 2026](https://statusbrew.com/insights/sprout-social-vs-agorapulse) ).


Best for mid-market to enterprise teams that want self-serve access without a sales cycle, and don't need video-content analysis out of the listening module.


### Emplifi: The Enterprise Ladder With Listening Bolted On Everywhere


Emplifi doesn't sell one product — it sells three: Social Marketing, Social Care, and Social Commerce, each on its own Essential/Advanced/Intelligent ladder. Only Social Marketing publishes self-serve pricing, at $1,249/month for Essential and $2,499/month for Advanced; Intelligent, plus the entire Care and Commerce lines, remain quote-only with no free trial (Source:[Emplifi Pricing, 2026](https://emplifi.io/pricing/) ; cross-checked against[listeningplatforms.com — Emplifi Pricing and Features, 2026](https://listeningplatforms.com/platforms/emplifi/) ). Social listening isn't bundled into any tier of any line — it's sold as a separate add-on across the entire product regardless of which line or tier you're on.


The one place Emplifi pulls ahead structurally: it's the only vendor here with a fully built Commerce line — reviews, UGC, and live commerce — that neither Sprout Social nor Agorapulse offers at all (Source:[Emplifi Pricing, 2026](https://emplifi.io/pricing/) ).


**Where Emplifi wins:** The most complete product surface on paper — marketing, care, and commerce as three real product lines rather than bolted-on features — and the only one of the three with dedicated Commerce tooling.


**Where it struggles:** Buying "all-in-one" here means stitching together three separate sales processes, since Care and Commerce require a quote. Its own listening documentation confirms TikTok coverage is capped at posts and comments with an @mention, limited to the top 1,000 by API constraint; Instagram coverage is post and Reels text only, excluding comments; and YouTube coverage is limited to title and description — nowhere does it touch the video itself (Source:[Emplifi Docs — Listening Data Sources, 2026](https://docs.emplifi.io/platform/latest/home/listening-data-sources-available-coverage) ).


Best for larger, enterprise-leaning teams that want marketing, care, and commerce genuinely unified — and that can absorb a listening add-on cost and a sales process on top of the published price.


### Agorapulse: The Cheapest Self-Serve Option, Listening Priced Per Query


Agorapulse runs three core tiers, all self-serve: Standard at $79/user/month (annual) or $99 monthly, Professional at $119 or $149, and Advanced at $149 or $199, plus a custom Enterprise tier. Every tier includes a genuine 30-day free trial with no credit card required (Source:[Agorapulse Pricing, 2026](https://www.agorapulse.com/pricing) ).


Listening lives outside all of that. Advanced Listening — Agorapulse's keyword, phrase, and mention-tracking feature across social platforms, blogs, forums, and news sites — is a common add-on across every tier, priced at $100 per search query per month, whether you're on Standard or Enterprise (Source:[Agorapulse Advanced Listening, 2026](https://support.agorapulse.com/en/articles/10365572-advanced-listening-explained) ). Agorapulse acquired the listening tool Mention in 2025, but more than a year later, Mention still runs as a separate, text-based monitoring product (Source:[Netinfluencer — Agorapulse acquires Mention, 2025](https://www.netinfluencer.com/listening-to-the-future-agorapulse-acquisition-of-mention-explained/) ).


**Where Agorapulse wins:** The lowest published entry price of the three, genuinely self-serve at every tier, and G2 reviewers consistently single out its customer support as a category strength (Source:[G2 — Agorapulse Reviews](https://www.g2.com/products/agorapulse/reviews) ).


**Where it struggles:** Listening isn't included anywhere — it's a per-query add-on regardless of which tier you're already paying for, and its documentation describes tracking public content by keyword, phrase, and mention with no mention of a TikTok-specific capture mechanism or any visual analysis.


Best for SMBs and small-to-mid agencies that want the cheapest self-serve entry and don't need listening depth beyond basic keyword tracking.


## The Module-Bundling Gap: Why More Features Doesn't Mean Deeper Listening


**Text/metadata-based listening** : a monitoring approach that identifies relevant content by matching keywords, hashtags, captions, @mentions, or post titles and descriptions — the mechanism behind all three platforms' listening modules today, regardless of how that module is priced or bundled. **Content-first, video-native listening** : identifying relevant mentions based on what's actually said or shown inside a video — the spoken audio and on-screen visuals — rather than relying on captions, hashtags, or follower counts.


Bundling structure is a red herring here. Sprout Social folds listening into a mid-tier plan, Emplifi sells it as an add-on across three separate product lines, and Agorapulse prices it per search query — three different shelves, same product underneath. All three confirm, through their own documentation, that listening never actually opens the video: it matches text.


-


Sprout Social's support team states plainly that it "cannot search and sync sound" on TikTok (Source:[Sprout Social Support — TikTok FAQs, 2026](https://support.sproutsocial.com/hc/en-us/articles/6136845197709-TikTok-FAQs) ).


-


Emplifi's own coverage documentation caps TikTok at @mentions in the top 1,000 posts and comments, reads Instagram post and Reels text only, and reduces YouTube to its title and description (Source:[Emplifi Docs — Listening Data Sources, 2026](https://docs.emplifi.io/platform/latest/home/listening-data-sources-available-coverage) ).


-


Agorapulse's Advanced Listening, even after acquiring Mention, tracks "public content that includes your keywords, phrases, or profile mentions" — explicitly text-based, with no documented video or on-screen-text analysis (Source:[Agorapulse Advanced Listening, 2026](https://support.agorapulse.com/en/articles/10365572-advanced-listening-explained) ).


All three fully support publishing to TikTok and Reels — they just can't listen to what's inside those videos once they're posted. That gap matters more every year video eats a bigger share of where customers actually talk about a brand: on camera, not in a caption.[Syncly Social's video analysis](https://syncly.app/social/feature/video-analysis) was built around the opposite premise — reading the spoken word and the on-screen visual as the primary signal, not an afterthought bolted onto a text-matching engine. That's the mechanic behind[Syncly's social listening solution](https://syncly.app/social/solution/social-listening) : content-first, video-native listening instead of caption-first keyword matching.


## Sprout Social vs Emplifi vs Agorapulse: Which One Should You Choose?


Skip the module checklist. Match the platform to your team size and budget first, then layer in how much listening depth you actually need.


-


**You're an SMB or small agency that wants the cheapest self-serve entry and don't need listening beyond keyword tracking →** Agorapulse fits, with the caveat that listening is always a $100/query add-on.


-


**You're a mid-market to enterprise team that wants listening bundled lower in the pricing ladder and a single AI layer tying modules together →** Sprout Social fits, especially once Trellis finishes rolling out across all four modules in July 2026.


-


**You need marketing, care, and commerce genuinely unified as three real product lines, and can clear a sales process for two of them →** Emplifi fits, particularly if UGC and live commerce tooling matter to your team.


-


**Your actual gap is understanding what's said or shown inside a video, not just what's typed in a caption →** none of these three currently closes that gap. That's the specific problem[Syncly Social](https://syncly.app/social) and its[competitor analysis solution](https://syncly.app/social/solution/competitor-analysis) were built to solve.


-

None of these three is a bad platform — they're built around different bundling logic entirely. The mistake is assuming "all-in-one" means the listening module inside that bundle actually understands video.


## Key Takeaways


-


Sprout Social bundles listening into its $199/month Standard tier; Emplifi sells listening as an add-on on every tier of every product line; Agorapulse prices listening at $100 per search query regardless of tier.


-


Emplifi is the only one of the three with a fully built Commerce line (reviews, UGC, live commerce), but only its Social Marketing line publishes self-serve pricing — Social Care and Social Commerce remain quote-only.


-


Sprout Social announced Trellis, an agentic AI layer spanning Publishing, Listening, Smart Inbox, and Reporting, on May 13, 2026, with full rollout completing in July 2026.


-


All three are confirmed, through their own documentation, to run text- and metadata-only listening — none transcribes audio or analyzes on-screen visuals, even on platforms like TikTok where they fully support publishing.


-


Agorapulse fits SMBs and small agencies best, Sprout Social fits mid-market to enterprise teams that want listening bundled lower in the ladder, and Emplifi fits teams that need marketing, care, and commerce genuinely unified under one roof.


## Conclusion


Sprout Social, Emplifi, and Agorapulse are all legitimate all-in-one social suites — they just bundle their modules around three different logics. Sprout Social bets on one AI layer tying four modules together. Emplifi bets on three fully built product lines, sold and priced separately. Agorapulse bets on the cheapest, simplest self-serve door in. None of the three bets on actually watching the video.


The real question in Sprout Social vs Emplifi vs Agorapulse isn't which vendor bundles the most modules — it's whether the module you care about most, listening, was built to read a caption or built to understand a video. Right now, all three read captions.
